risks.risk: Parts may not fit the buyer's specific engine or vehicle due to lack of brand/model identification.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part with visible brand, model, or part number, or a photo showing the part installed on a known vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic, non-fitment parts, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Parts may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked, bent, or worn-out).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each part showing condition, especially the mounting surfaces and bolts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged, reducing value.

risks.risk: Parts may be counterfeit or reconditioned without disclosure.
risks.proof: Photo of the part's serial number or manufacturer label, if any.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified quality, which may be lower than genuine parts.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate with the model number or engine number.
Clear photo of the part with visible brand, model, or part number.
Close-up photos of each part showing condition and mounting surfaces.
Photo of any serial number or manufacturer label on the part.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
